cli.factor-id: required for relations; exact directory ID
cli.query: required for search; source ID/name/name_en substring
cli.directory-input: normalized directory file for offline search
cli.source-input: raw matching API envelope, no HTTP

dataContract.factors: original IDs and provider metadata; names not unique
dataContract.edges: original from/to, raw corr_sign, pass_score and supplied description/delay
dataContract.limitations: not validated causality; no coefficient/confidence or numeric code mapping inferred
